You code is fairly lengthy and I haven't had the time to go through it in detail or test it. Based on what I understand what you are trying to do, here is a suggestion (you can try other variations of this approach).

Define the reactiveValues thus:

         vals <- reactiveValues(
            flag = FALSE,
            data = data.frame() 
            )

Update the plot1 output thus:

         output$plot1 <- renderPlot({
        
            if (vals$flag == FALSE) {
              plot_data<-df_upload_data()
            }
            else {
                plot_data<-vals$data
            }

            ggplot(plot_data, aes_string(x = input$column1, y = input$column2)) + geom_point()
            
          })

A suitable modification can be done to the observe that follows.
Hope this helps.
